channels.description: The agent's reasoning and progress for the task, appended in order. A claim, never evidence.
Questions the agent raises for a person. The agent appends a question; the answer and its acceptance belong to the block's human owner.
Results of the agent's tool calls, written by the service from the tool result with the tool's version, image digest, and inputs. Read-only to everyone.
Objects handed to the task by event (the approved spec, the other side's sealed findings, a person's dispositions), placed by the service after their digest verifies. Read-only.
A person's decisions on a review round's findings, sealed on submit.
